text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A 100 percent hike in domestic airfares by airlines is ruled illegal by Aviation Minister Air Commodore Ita Udo-Imeh.
- Former military ruler General Ibrahim Babangida flies to France for his annual holiday.
- World Bank team in Nigeria for talks on proposed federal government privatisation programme.
- Corporate Affairs Commission registers 2,000 business at Lagos trade fair during the 10 days the event lasted.
- Engine of Nigerian plane which crashed last Thursday has now been found.
- Multinational oil firms operating in Nigeria may from now on shun local airlines because of Thursday's crash of ADC airline's Boeing 727 which killed all 142 people on board.
- Enugu State government in eastern Nigeria charged at failed banks tribunal over debt of 184 million naira it owes the distressed Co-opertive and Commerce Bank Limited.
- Lack of spare parts has grounded most of Nigeria's fishing trawlers, operators say.
- Benue Cement Company on the march at the Nigerian stock exchange; recorded highest price rise of 36 kobo on Monday.
